encoder: legalese-sonnet-5.5: one Sonnet 5.5 agent working alone, solo, no sub-agents
display_name: BKV § 9(5) with IFG §§ 1, 3 to 6, access to the Council's papers: a law layer, two layers of a seat for the requester (one input for the other grounds, and every ground spelled out), the Art. 80(1) sentence 3 citation test, and a seat for a worker asking whether a disease is listed (BKV § 1(1), Anlage 1 No. 1322)
seats: a person who asks a federal authority for a document about the Expert Advisory Council on Occupational Diseases, asking whether they are entitled to access under the Freedom of Information Act and whether § 9(5) BKV makes the document confidential (two layers: bkv-seat.l4, which asks whether another ground for refusal applies as one input, and bkv-ifg-seat.l4, which asks each ground of IFG §§ 3 to 6)

a worker who has a disease and asks whether it is a listed occupational disease: BKV § 1(1) with Anlage 1 No. 1322, Parkinson syndrome from long-term, frequent and self-applied pesticides, under two readings of the Seventh Amending Regulation (bkv-worker-seat.l4)
edition: BKV §§ 1, 8, 9, Anlage 1 (heading and Nos. 1321 and 1322 only), Eingangsformel; IFG §§ 1, 3, 4, 5, 6; SGB VII § 9; Grundgesetz Art. 80, as printed on gesetze-im-internet.de on 2026-11-02; BGBl. 2026 I Nr. 210 (gazette text and PDF); Bundesrat Drucksache 312/26; Bundestag Drucksache 19/17586 pp. 47-48, 101-102 and 130-132; BVerwG 7 C 4.11; BVerfG 2 BvF 3/90 paras. 151 to 158 (../../registers/source-bundle/).
not_reviewed: No domain expert has read this encoding against the text. The consolidated texts are the site's reading versions; the Seventh Amending Regulation and the Drucksache were read from their own texts. Bundestag document 19/17586 (pp. 101 to 102) and BVerwG 7 C 4.11 (paras. 29 to 34) were read as excerpts; the full earlier wording of § 9(5) sentence 2 is not deposited. The tests' expected values were written by the encoder from the text, not by an independent author. The grounds of IFG §§ 3 to 6 and the worker's entry rest on texts that are not deposited: IFG §§ 2 and 7 to 9, Security Clearance Act § 10 no. 3 (read, not deposited), Article 9(1) of the General Data Protection Regulation, SGB VII §§ 2, 3 and 6, and the Council's published recommendation on the Parkinson entry; the judgments the grounds depend on are inputs and are not guessed.

scope.intent: BKV § 9(5) sentences 1 to 3; IFG § 1(1) and § 3 no. 4, and the other grounds for refusing access, IFG § 3 nos. 1 to 3 and 5 to 8, § 4(1), § 5(1) to (3) and § 6; SGB VII § 9(1a) sentence 4 as the power needed for the confidentiality rule, and § 9(1) sentences 1 and 2 as the power for the new entry; the preambles of the BKV and the Seventh Amending Regulation; Grundgesetz Art. 80(1) sentence 3 as the citation test; BKV § 1(1) with Anlage 1 No. 1322 (the Parkinson entry, in force 1 August 2026), under two readings of the Seventh Amending Regulation. Not the rest of the Regulation, the Act, the rest of Anlage 1, IFG §§ 2 and 7 to 15, SGB VII § 9(2) and (2a) (the route for a disease that is not listed), or § 5(4) IFG.
